answer: Steps: Alarm management is concerned with improving the QUALITY of the information within the alarming configuration. This information should be used to reduce the QUANTITY of nuisance alarms (red herrings) so that only the most important and relevant alarms are displayed for your process. In other words, alarm management can counteract inefficient alarming. title: About DataBinders
question: What is The main difference between a Select query and a DataBinder?
answer: Although this seems similar to the function performed by a Select query, the main difference between a query and DataBinder is that: - Select queries (and the queries in previous versions) only return static snapshots of the selected data that are only current at the time at which the query is performed. - DataBinders remain in constant communication with the database and so can provide a ‘live’ view of your data, if necessary.

title: About Power Factor
question: What is About Power Factor?
answer: The importance of the power factor lies in the fact that electricity providers supply customers with volt-amperes, but bill them for watts. Power factors below 1.0 require an electricity provider to generate more than the minimum volt-amperes necessary to supply the real power (watts). Since this increases the electricity provider’s generation and transmission costs, they may charge additional costs to customers who have a power factor below some limit.

title: ACK Commands
question: What is ACK Commands?
answer: Function: To acknowledge alarms reported by an agent within the Agent Server. Note1: Alarms are always globally acknowledged. Note2: This command must be enabled by the Command agent , which it is sent to, before it can be performed, because it can create a security and operational risk through the remote acknowledgment of alarms. For details, see Specifying Permitted Commands .

title: Active Clusters Foundation
question: What is Clustering Agent Servers?
answer: Steps: Clustered Agent Servers, previously known as hot standby, provide both client and server redundancy enabling high availability of the system. Typically, redundancy can be applied to all the levels within the plant. For more details on addressing the important issues that affect the operation and configuration of clustered Adroit Agent Servers, see Important Points to consider when . title: Adding the slots we're interested in
question: What is Adding the slots we're interested in?
answer: Steps: For details, see Steps required to Monitor Real-time Data . Initially the Properties collection object contains no Property objects, but it provides a method named Add that is used to add Property objects to the Properties collection. Each Property object in the Properties collection defines a slot to be monitored. The Add method accepts one parameter, the required slot name. The following VBA code shows how to add the value and rawValue slots to the Properties collection: Set prop = props.Add("value") Set prop = props.Add("rawValue") Once the Properties collection is set up, it must be associated with a tag as part of a Request object.

title: Adroit Logging Factor
question: What is Adroit Logging Factor?
answer: Steps: When Adroit logging was originally developed in 1992 a design criteria was accepted which has come to prove problematic for some installations in the real world. Up until 1992 the generally accepted default practice was for users to datalog all points at 1 second. However, due to CPU, HDD speeds and serial protocol speeds, the fastest data could only logged at 4-5 seconds. Therefore the log file created by Adroit was deliberately engineered to always be 20% of the expected size, since Adroit only stores data when it in physically changes.

question: How do I configure Adroit M2M Protocol in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The Adroit M2M Protocol utilizes Hist Mask and MEMTYPE settings to translate physical PLC words to logical RTU words. Unsolicited and History reporting can be enabled, and data is transmitted in fixed records of 4 or 8 words, prioritizing the oldest records for transmission.

question: How do I configure Notes in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The Adroit M2M protocol uses READCFG and READSTATS messages to fetch configuration and statistics data from the PLC. title: Agent Subscriptions
question: What is Agent Subscriptions?
answer: The concept of a subscription is based on the principle of “listening” for updates from a specific Agent tag (or slot). - The process of subscribing is setting up the “listener”, by registering with the underlying mechanism of the relevant agent tag. - Other traditional mechanisms usually rely on explicitly reading a data point to update a value, where as subscriptions allow the change to be sent asynchronously to any “listeners”.

answer: Agents are the fundamental building blocks of Adroit . For further details, see About Agents . Note: In Adroit , the data or values contained within agents are called slots.

title: Alarm Shelving
question: What is Working with Alarm Shelving (Alarm Inhibiting)?
answer: Working with (Alarm Inhibiting) This is process of temporarily removing (deactivating) one or more alarms from the entire alarm system (not just the local client), typically for a specific time period. Then when the time is up, if the alarm was active at the time that it was shelved, it will again be added to the alarm system.

question: What is Alternate Secondary Port Enabled?
answer: Using the same PC port / resource, but different PLC ports / resources. For this to be effective, the PLCs used need to have separate addresses and both PLCs need to be able to be independently accessed by the Adroit .

title: Animating graphic forms
question: What is Animating graphic forms?
answer: Animating a graphic form involves connecting data to the graphic form and its added form components. The purpose of animating a graphic form, is literally to enliven a graphic form, causing it to both display data and to allow the end-users to interact with and manipulate your data in the SmartUI Operator. For an example of using a DataBinder to read and/or write data in a database to and/from a control on a graphic form, see How to write and or read database data from a control .

title: Automatic WGP File Backups
question: What is Automatic WGP File Backups?
answer: Adroit WGP files can be automatically backed up when they are saved to ensure that at most only the changes made since the last save will be lost. Both the number of days for which these files are to be saved for and the maximum number of backup files can be specified to avoid backup duplication and conserve disk space.

title: Automatically hiding and showing tool windows
question: What is Automatically hiding and showing tool windows?
answer: Docked tool windows support an auto-hiding feature to conserve space within the work environment. When auto hidden, a tab is created for the tool window on the respective border of the SmartUI Designer, depending upon its docking area. For instance if the tool window is docked to the left of the Design workspace , then a tab will be created on the left border of the SmartUI Designer application window.

title: Backing Up Adroit Database (.WGP) Files
question: What is Backing Up Adroit Database (.WGP) Files?
answer: Steps: The Adroit database or .WGP file stores almost all of the data and configuration of the Agent Server, including the added agents, their values and their alarming, logging and scanning configuration. For this reason, it is essential that this file, along with the other Adroit project files, be frequently backed up to ensure that the integrity of this data is preserved. Since if this file is either deleted or becomes corrupted without having a recent backup, many man hours of effort will be lost.

title: Basic Principles of DbAccess Agents
question: What is Basic Principles of DbAccess Agents?
answer: Each DbAccess Agent represents a transaction on a row, in a table, in a database. Before any transactions can take place, a connection to a database has to be established and a table in this database has to be identified, that requires or contains the information necessary for a transaction. IMPORTANT: If you are connecting to a database across the network and your Agent Server is running as a service, then ensure that the user profile that the Agent Server service uses to log onto the computer HAS the necessary rights to browse the network and connect to the remote database.

title: Basic principles of server mode assignment strategies in Adroit
question: What is Basic principles of server mode assignment strategies in Adroit?
answer: The state of a cluster server is recorded in the systeminfo.serverMode (0, 1, 2 = master, standby, normal respectively) and systeminfo.serverState (0, 1 = unhealthy, healthy respectively) slots for every cluster server. A new cluster server always starts up as a standby server. The serverstate slot always starts up as healthy and remains as such unless the user changes it to unhealthy (0) via a script, expression agent or a similar means.

answer: The Analog agent can be enabled to calculate the following statistics from its value slot: sum (total), average, standard deviation, minimum, maximum and direction of change (trend). These statistics are only calculated, when the Integer statsPeriod slot is set to the number of minutes that you want the value slot to be recorded for statistical evaluation.

title: Catch-up
question: What is Catch-up?
answer: When a new server is added to the cluster, it must become a mirror image of the active member of the cluster. The new server must restore its historical data (historical ) that it lost during the down time. This historical synchronization or Datalog is facilitated by a new agent called the SystemDatalog agent .

question: What is Code to execute a script on the Server?
answer: Add the following : Note :The special function called “ExecuteServerScriptObject” allows a named script to be executed on the Server. string __dataSourceName = "s1"; string __scriptName = "a1"; string __vsoName = __dataSourceName + "." + __scriptName; VIZNET.Shared.ScriptEngine.VIZNETScriptObject __vso = new VIZNET.Shared.ScriptEngine.VIZNETScriptObject(); // Read the VSO MethodReturnInfo __mri = MyConnection.ReadDataElements( new string [] { __vsoName } ); if (__mri.Success ) { DataElementCollection __dec = __mri.ReturnObject as DataElementCollection; if (__dec != null ) { __vso = __dec.GetElementByKeyValue(__vsoName).Value as VIZNETScriptObject; } else { return ; } // Execute the script on the server: VIZNET.Shared.XML.FunctionXMLDOM function = new FunctionXMLDOM(); function.Name = "ExecuteScriptObject"; function.AddParam( "vso", typeof (VIZNET.Shared.ScriptEngine.VIZNETScriptObject).AssemblyQualifiedName); function.SetParamValue( 0, __vso); MessageBox.Show( typeof ( VIZNET.Shared.ScriptEngine.VIZNETScriptObject ).ToString()); MessageBox.Show(__vso.SourceText.ToString()); MethodReturnInfo info = MyConnection.CallSpecialFunction( MyConnection.DefaultServerName, __dataSourceName, function ); if (!info.Success) { MyApplication.ShowException( new Exception(info.ReturnInformation)); } }

question: What is Save your mimic in the Classic UI to a XAML file?
answer: Steps: Save your mimic in the Classic UI, as normal Select Yes to the confirmation dialog to also create a XAML file. title: Converting output data types
question: What is To add a type conversion for an output?
answer: Steps: - Open the required spider workspace. - If necessary, display the configuration view of this spider by double clicking its title bar. - In the Outputs section, right click the required output and select the required conversion from the Convert Output menu. Note: The available conversions depend upon the data type of the selected output. title: Creating IOT Expressions
question: What is Creating an IOT agent using expressions in the XML slot?
answer: If you want to create an x+y=z agent with alarming when the z value exceeds 100 then the xml slot of this agent would have the following structure: <IOT Name="AddingTwoNumbers" Description="This adds two real values together"><Slots><Slot Name="x" Description="X value" Type="Real">0</Slot><Slot Name="y" Description="Y value" Type="Real">0</Slot><Slot Name="z" Description="Z value" Type="Real">0</Slot></Slots><HeaderSlots><Slot Name="hi"/></HeaderSlots></IOT> And the expression slot of this agent would saved as: Z=slot(x) + slot(y)\r\n\r\nstatus16 = slot(z) > 100 Which, appears in the Expression edit box in the configuration dialog of this IOT agent as follows: Z=slot(x) + slot(y) status16 = slot(z) > 100 Note: The use of the empty line between these expressions, indicates that they are separate independent expressions.

If you want to create an x+y=z agent with alarming when the z value exceeds 100 then the xml slot of this agent would have the following structure: <IOT Name="AddingTwoNumbers" Description="This adds two real values together"><Slots><Slot Name="x" Description="X value" Type="Real">0</Slot><Slot Name="y" Description="Y value" Type="Real">0</Slot><Slot Name="z" Description="Z value" Type="Real">0</Slot></Slots><HeaderSlots><Slot Name="hi"/></HeaderSlots></IOT> And the expression slot of this agent would saved as: Z=slot(x) + slot(y)\r\n\r\nstatus16 = slot(z) > 100 Which, appears in the Expression edit box in the configuration dialog of this IOT agent as follows: Z=slot(x) + slot(y) status16 = slot(z) > 100 Note: The use of the empty line between these expressions, indicates that they are separate independent expressions. expressions adroit scada creating smart ui - other ui creating iot expressions adroit other html iot smart

title: Creating the Requests collection
question: What is Creating the Requests collection?
answer: Steps: For details, see Steps required to Monitor Real-time Data . One of the objects exposed by the Data Object is the Requests collection, a collection of individual descriptions for required real-time data. Each description consists of a tag (or agent name) plus the names of all the slots to be monitored. The slot names are gathered into another collection called the Properties collection. Since the Data Object provides the Requests collection as one of its properties, the VBA code to gain access to the Requests collection is simply: Set reqs = dataObj.Requests A single request consists of the tag plus the names of all slots to be monitored.

title: Data Specification Method for Statistical Agent
question: What is Specifications?
answer: The method of data sampling offered by the Statistical agent is called STREAMING, whereby all the collected input values are placed in one sample for analysis. Each input value may be collected on an event basis, and is called a STREAM EVENT. The Stream Event method takes the input agent’s values, either when triggered by another agent, or when its input value changes, and calculates the statistical data (Maximum, Minimum, Average, Standard Deviation, Total and Rate) for all the values collected, treating the values as being part of a single sample.

title: Data Structure of an Agent
question: What is Data Structure of an Agent?
answer: Most agents are designed to contain multiple items of data, which are referred to as agent attributes. An agent's "state", at any instant in time, is defined as the collective values of all its data.

title: Database Folder
question: What is Database Folder?
answer: Steps: The WanClient application requires a folder to store the files that contain the tag link database, which it manages. For further details on what this database is and what it contains, see Tag Link Databases . By default, this folder is called ‘WanlinkDB’ and is created as a sub-folder off the Adroit installation folder, so its default location is ‘ C:\Program Files\Adroit Technologies\Adroit \WanLinkDB’. However, an alternate location and / or name can be specified for this folder, if necessary, by adding the following registry key to the Adroit registry: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\Wanlink Then add the following String value to this registry key and set it to the fully qualified path of the desired folder: (REG_) SZ DatabaseFolder = the fully qualified path of the desired folder e.g.

title: Effective Alarm Characteristics
question: What is Effective Alarm Characteristics?
answer: The characteristic of an effective alarm is that it should be: - Relevant: requiring acknowledgment and corrective action i.e. NOT an event that can simply be ignored. - Unique: does not duplicate another alarm and is not a secondary consequence of a previous alarm. - Timely: is not triggered too long before any response is needed or too late to do anything.

title: Endress & Hauser Promag 800 Email
question: How do I configure Endress & Hauser Promag 800 Email in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The Endress & Hauser Promag 800 Email driver in Adroit SCADA allows flow meters to send data as a CSV attachment within an email. The email is then decoded to expose the values contained within the attachment and body of the email. To use this driver, a separate Adroit device must be created for each flow meter, with the station ID set to the flow meter’s serial number as defined in the CSV file.

question: How do I configure 1.0 Overview in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The EnvisaLink™ TPI allows third-party command and control applications to connect directly to the EnvisaLink™ module and security system via a TCP/IP connection. title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is Calculation duration?
answer: The OEE agent uses a background engine to update the monitored KPI or OEE in real-time. Any changes made to the input slots, determines how this background engine does its calculations. Note: Ensure that your Adroit license has specified the required number of OEE agents, which are specified in groups of 10. WITHOUT specifying the licensed number of OEE agents, only one instance of an OEE agent has its background engine enabled.

title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is Running time?
answer: KPI calculations are performed against runtime. Therefore the OEE agent uses the BOOLEAN running slot (or the optional BOOLEAN tag reference runningTag ) that informs the agent whether the process (or machine) is running. is typically automatically incremented by the agent while this BOOLEAN value is ON. IMPORTANT: The OEE agent only supports BOOLEAN tags - so you cannot use an expression value tag.

title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is Available time?
answer: Whereas KPI calculations are performed against runtime, OEE calculations are calculated against the time that the process/machine is available for production. The OEE agent therefore uses the BOOLEAN available slot (or the optional BOOLEAN tag reference availableTag ) to determine the maximum . - This slot should be ON when the machine/process is supposed to be running.

title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is Complex mode and KPI calculation?
answer: To allow for KPIs that have one measurement divided by another measurement (other than time), such as kWh/ton- the OEE agent supports a second measurement input slot ( input2 ). For normal OEE and KPI calculations, input2 is not used and the input type is set to Unused (0), by default. In this case the input1 slot is divided by time.

title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is OEE calculations?
answer: The OEE agent performs using the following formula: OEE% = Quality% * Performance% * Availability% Where: Quality% = Quality factor(%) * ((Total for the Shift - Reject Count)/Total for the Shift) Performance% = Total for the Shift/(Design capacity (per hour) * Run time) Availability (hours)% = Run time/Available time Availability Percent of scheduled production (to measure reliability) or calendar hours 24/7/365 (to measure equipment utilization), that equipment is available for production.

title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
question: What is Quality factor?
answer: Quality can be calculated in many ways, depending on the type of process and the variables/information available to calculate quality. Therefore, the OEE agent calculates the quality using the reject and total counts for the shift, which is multiplied by an external , expressed as a percentage. This % value (the qualityFactor slot) is the external whose value (0 to 100) must be driven externally.

title: Getting to know the Collections
question: What is Getting to know the Collections?
answer: WOSA/XRT Data Objects make extensive use of the OLE collection construct. A collection is an object that is implemented such that a well-known set of methods exists for iterating over the collected sub-objects. The defined Behaviours provide for enumeration, addition, deletion, and access via index. A collection contains only objects of the same class. The way collections are named is to typically call the collection the plural of the collected object name.

title: Glossary
question: What is @scan (pronounced at-scan), which is a method of linking the value of one tag to another, by scanning the required tag value directly. active the monitored condition of this incident (alarm/event) is still in effect and has not yet returned to its normal operating state. agent an instance of an agent type, that stores data and typically provides the ability to operate or act on this data. agent group an agent that facilitates the logical grouping of other agents. For example, an AgentGroup agent could contain all agents related to a specific section of a plant, or all agents required for a specific report. alarm the process of monitoring an agent for the occurrence of a specific abnormal condition or state (alarm type). alarm type a named (abnormal) condition or state of an agent that is defined by which of its status bits are simultaneously ON or OFF, which can also list the slots of this agent to report when this condition occurs. alarming strategy a set of guidelines or a plan to optimise the configuration of the alarming of agents. title: Golden Rules for Scanning
question: What is Golden Rules for Scanning?
answer: Rule 1: If available, scan the rawValue not the value slot, this is especially important for Analogs. Rule 2: Never scan signed values into Marshal or Multistate agents, typically scan device addresses that end in "I" or "L". Rule 3: Do not scan faster than you need to.

title: Historical Alarm mode
question: What is Historical Alarm mode?
answer: allows an unlicensed AlarmManagement agent to save your historical alarms to a SQL Server database. Up to now, an unlicensed AlarmManagement agent only allowed the fully fledged AlarmManagement system to be used for one hour. The main advantage of using this is that previously the life-cycle of an alarm, such as when it was initiated, when viewed, when acknowledged and when cleared (removed) could only be determined by looking at several lines from the relevant AlarmList, but now this you allows you to see the full life-cycle of each alarm in a single row in the Adr_AM_HistoricalIncidents table of the Adroit Historical Alarms database that is created for you in the specified SQL Server that you need to specify.

title: Historical Data Catch Up of the Newly Added Standby Server
question: What is Historical Data Catch Up of the Newly Added Standby Server?
answer: When a standby server joins a cluster, the historical data stored on the master server must be mirrored over to the standby server. This is done in an intelligent manner by only copying over the data that it requires, that is, the data stored by the master during the period that the newly added standby server was down.

title: How MAPS implements the S88 / S95 hierarchy
question: What is How MAPS implements the S88 / S95 hierarchy?
answer: The ISA S95 standard divides the manufacturing enterprise into: plant floor automation control, MES and ERP. This standard focuses on MES and ERP, as its goal is to seamlessly coordinate business and production processes. The ISA S88 standard, originally created for batch processes, can be used to structure ANY process. This standard focuses on plant floor automation control.

title: How Maximum Demand is Calculated
question: What is Maximum demand calculation example:?
answer: Assuming that the power consumption on a plant over a block period of 30 minutes is comprised of 5 different episodes of consumption as follows: - 800 kVA for 5 minutes - 200 kVA for 5 minutes - 400 kVA for 10 minutes - 800 kVA for 8 minutes - 1500 kVA for 2 minutes Adroit calculates the maximum demand for that 30 minute period as follows: ((800*5) + (200*5) + (400*10) + (800*8) + (1500*2)) / 30 = 613.33 kVA During each of the above five episodes the predicted maximum demand would have been: - Episode1: (800*30) / 30 = 800 kVA - Episode2: ((800*5) + (200*25)) / 30 = 300 kVA - Episode3: ((800*5) + (200*5) + (400*20)) / 30 = 433.33 kVA - Episode4: ((800*5) + (200*5) + (400*10) + (800*10)) / 30 = 566.66 kVA - Episode5: ((800*5) + (200*5) + (400*10) + (800*8) + (1500*2)) / 30 = 613.33 kVA If this agent had a configured maximum demand limit of 600 kVA and the Enable max demand alarm checkbox is enabled, then the MaxDemand status bit would have been on during episodes 1 and 5.

question: What is Configuration?
answer: The DBLog agent is a bulk OLE DB logging agent for typically logging Analog and/or Digital values to a specific table in a database for later retrieval. This provides various different logging methods, such as “log on change”, “log on interval” etc. For a detailed description of , see Configuring DBLog Agents . Tip: Typically you need to separate the Analog and Digital tags that you want to log into different DBLog agents, due to their unique logging requirements.

title: How to cluster Servers
question: What is Configuration?
answer: Steps: When configuring load balancing, it is often useful to group the SmartUI Operators that connect to a cluster into more than one set. Then modify the ClusterServers setting for each of these sets, so that the order in which they connect to the Servers within the cluster differ. For example, if we have three sets of SmartUI Operators that need to connect to this cluster, then each of their CONFIG files could be configured with three different ClusterServers settings.

title: How to cluster Servers
question: What is Notes?
answer: Steps: The INITIAL connection for the SmartUI Operator MUST have a running SmartUI Server. In other words, if a SmartUI Operator is configured to connect to the SmartUI Server on Computer3, this SmartUI Server MUST be running, otherwise the initial log on of this SmartUI Operator will fail. From then on if this SmartUI Server fails, this SmartUI Operator will hunt until it finds an active connection. The speed at which this occurs is determined by its switch-over time.

title: How to Connect to the SmartUI Server over the Web
question: What is How to Connect to the SmartUI Server over the Web?
answer: Steps: - Navigate to the SmartUI Web Services installation folder, typically this is: C:\Program Files\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\SmartUI\Webservice . - Locate the “Web.config” file in this folder. - Open this “Web.config” file in a text editor, such as Notepad. Its first four lines should appear as follows: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?> <configuration> <appSettings> <add key="server" value="localhost" /> - Modify the “localhost”, so that the value refers to either the network name of the remote Server computer or its IP address.

answer: When troubleshooting potential driver problems, it is essential to understand exactly how the specific device of an installed driver is communicating between Adroit and the specified front-end device. question: What is Subscribe-Poll?

answer: Wizards: Wizards allow you to reuse the same graphical object and its assigned Behaviours (if any), over and over again, with different values (data elements), without having to recreate this object from scratch ever time. question: What is Associating a Key to an Item Displayed in a ComboBox or ListBox Control?
answer: A common usage of the ComboBox control (or ListBox control) is to select the index or key column of a database, however these values are usually not descriptive enough to be very user-friendly. However, there is usually another column in the database that contains descriptive values. It is now possible to BOTH select the required index or key column value using the ComboBox control and to obtain the associated, more descriptive value, from the other column of this database too.

title: How to Use the Backup Utility
question: What is How to Use this Adroit Backup Utility?
answer: Steps: Use the Adroit Backup utility to create a complete backup of your Adroit projects and/or the Adroit installation files. WARNING: All Custom agents and their files (*.DLL, *.VBS, *.CSV) need to be manually backed up. Note: Ensure that the Adroit Agent Server and/or User Interface and any other Adroit programs, such as MISSRVR, are not running. If necessary launch this utility: Press the Windows key and start typing in the required application name and select it from the list, in this case: Backup Utility When the Adroit Backup Program is open: - Specify the required location where these backups must be placed, this is c:\adroit.backup, by default.

title: How to use the IOT agent to define an object
question: What is Using the addSlot?
answer: The format for this slot is as follows: slottypeidx,slotname[,slotdescription[,slotvalue]] Where: slottypeidx : is a slot type index as follows: 0 : boolean (1/0) 1 : integer (4 byte signed integer) 2 : real (8 byte float) 3 : string (79 characters) 4 : time 5 : tagname (67 chars) (see “Use of Tagname type slots” below) 10 : varstring (any number of characters) slotname : any valid slotname not exceeding 15 characters and not containing the characters $ @ , \ & % * ?

title: How to use the IOT agent to define an object

answer: The format for this slot is as follows: slottypeidx,slotname[,slotdescription[,slotvalue]] Where: slottypeidx : is a slot type index as follows: 0 : boolean (1/0) 1 : integer (4 byte signed integer) 2 : real (8 byte float) 3 : string (79 characters) 4 : time 5 : tagname (67 chars) (see “Use of Tagname type slots” below) 10 : varstring (any number of characters) slotname : any valid slotname not exceeding 15 characters and not containing the characters $ @ , \ & % * ?

question: What is Implementation on a 32 bit operating system:?
answer: 32 bit operating systems have a maximum of 4GB of addressable memory space. By default, Windows allows only 2GB per process and uses the other 2GB for Windows itself. To change this default, you need to do the following: - On 32 bit Windows Vista and later versions of Windows: Use the IncreaseUserVA element in BCDEdit .

title: Indicators
question: What is Analogue Indicators?
answer: Purpose: to graphically indicate the current value of an analogue (floating point) process variable (PV), by means of a sliding pointer along a horizontal or vertical range defined by the currently specified Maximum and Minimum engineering span of this Analogue process variable, while also indicating its currently specified normal operating range. Description: A horizontal or vertical rectangle, whereby: - the normal operating range (the values between the High and Low alarm limits) is filled in light blue and - the minimum and maximum allowable range (the values between the High High and the High and the Low Low and the Low alarm limits) are filled in dark grey and - the minimum and maximum extremes (the values between the Engineering Maximum and the High High alarm limit and the Engineering Minimum and Low Low alarm limit) are filled in black and - the current value is indicated by means of dark blue triangle sliding pointer and - ONLY if the statsPeriod slot of the Analog agent representing this process variable is configured, then a directional arrow may also be displayed indicating the current direction of trend i.e.

title: Installing WanServer as a Service
question: What is Installing WanServer as a Service?
answer: Steps: The WanServer can run either as a standard Application or as a Service within Windows. The advantage of running this as a Service is that then the WanServer does not shutdown when the current user logs off. Tip: It is recommended that the WanServer is initially run as an Application, which provides more diagnostic information during the configuration period. ONLY once Wanlink is configured and running properly, then run the WanServer Service Setup application and install the WanServer as a Service.

title: IO Flags
question: What is IO Flags?
answer: Steps: In an effort to simplify the scanning configuration, the following legacy status slots that used to affect how a slot (value) was scanned: Scan Inhibit, Output Enable and Output Initialise are no longer stored in the header of the each agent for each of its slots. Note: The advanced header dialog no longer displays these statuses and putslots to these status bits are also disabled. Instead these settings are now stored in the scanning configuration of the Device agent in the Agent Database (.wgp) file along with the other scanning related settings, such as the scan address, scan rate etc, as an setting.

title: Issues related to using Remote Desktop to Run Adroit
question: What is Problems running the Agent Server?
answer: You cannot start the Agent Server as an application by using the Windows Remote Desktop (a terminal client). This is because Windows does not support USB ports when you use the Remote Desktop application, so any USB HASP is effectively invisible to the Agent Server. Note: This is not a problem when starting the Agent Server as a service from within a Remote Desktop.

title: Manual Master Mode Assignment
question: What is Rules and implications?
answer: - There cannot be more than one master server in a cluster. Hence making a server master will immediately switch the other server to standby mode. - The serverMode and serverState slots between Agent Servers and within an Agent Server are not replicated. - All other server and client clustering operations will operate as normal given the slot values, irrespective of whether a manual or automatic master mode assignment method is used.

title: Monitoring Changing Values
question: What is Monitoring Changing Values?
answer: The Analog and Digital agents provide a change monitoring feature, which is disabled by default, in which a Changed status bit is pulsed when the value (slot) of the agent changes. ONLY use this feature when your operators need to IMMEDIATELY be made aware of ANY change to an Analog or Digital value. In this case you need to: - Enable change monitoring for the Analog or Digital agent, as follows: Either edit the agent and check its Enable change monitoring for this agent checkbox or set its BOOLEAN enableChange slot to 1.

question: What is Monitoring Scanning in Adroit?
answer: Steps: The Scanning Monitor utility is designed to assist experienced users in fine-tuning the Adroit scanning subsystem to achieve optimal performance, by providing an intuitive report-like view of advanced diagnostic information. This utility provides information on the scanning (communications) configuration for a particular Agent Server to and from its configured front-end devices, such as PLCs, RTUs etc. and is particularly useful in tuning polled driver's polling intervals. How to use the Scanning Monitor Tip: The Scanning Monitor utility can generate a report of your current scanning configuration of an Agent Server to indicate how well it has been configured.

title: MultiState Operation
question: What is MultiState Operation?
answer: On reaching a new state, a MultiState agent automatically carries out the following actions: - The new state is recorded as the current state. - The new state’s description is recorded as the current state description. - Any outputs in the new state’s output-true list are set TRUE. - Any outputs in the new state’s output-false list are set FALSE.

title: New Adroit Scanning Architecture (NASA) ver 1
question: How do I configure New Adroit Scanning Architecture (NASA) ver 1 in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The Adroit Scanning Architecture (NASA) ver 1 driver automatically handles data fetching by mapping I/O addresses near each other into a single task, optimizing for the largest possible data blocks (PDU length). This is based on an algorithm designed to fetch data efficiently. However, double-polling can occur when I/O addresses for different data types (like IEEE floats and counters) are interspersed, requiring the driver to create separate tasks for conversion.

title: New Adroit Scanning Architecture (NASA) ver 1
question: How do I configure saving communications bandwidth in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The Adroit scanning subsystem currently uses continuous polling, which can consume significant bandwidth. To manage bandwidth, you must create a separate device agent for each plant segment and stop the agent when data is no longer needed. The new architecture addresses this by shifting scan task scheduling to the protocol driver, eliminating the need for scan agents.

Specifically, Bit 0 enables reads, Bit 1 enables writes, Bit 2 initializes output, and Bit 3 performs a demand scan. title: Order of Execution of a Step of a Recipe Agent
question: What is Order of Execution of a Step of a Recipe Agent?
answer: Steps: - Set the ingredient to the value in the relevant Control Recipe. - Check to see if this step is an End of Phase. - If not, carry on to next step. - If it is, do all verification checking for this phase. If verification fails, stop execution or perform the configured rollback action. If verification succeeds, perform the phase action.

title: Performance Monitoring
question: What is Performance Monitoring?
answer: Steps: The PerfMon agent has been created for measuring the performance of your own computer or other computers on a network. On each computer, you can view the Behaviour of objects such as the Agent Server, processors, memory, cache, threads, and other processes. Since Adroit is a 32 bit application, if you have installed a 64 bit operating system then when you run the default Performance Monitor (PERFMON.EXE) all the counters for Adroit will be missing, because the 64 bit version of PERFMON is being run which can only load 64bit counter dlls!

title: Philosophy for End User Applications
question: What is Philosophy for End User Applications?
answer: The general philosophy is for the user to create an instance of a coarse grained object, and then instruct the object to create many finer grained objects inside itself. A coarse grained object corresponds to a connection to a known Agent Server, either running on the same computer as the application, or some other computer on a local- or wide-area network.

title: PID Alarm Limits
question: What is Limitations?
answer: The PID agent type provides alarming capabilities for both the PV (process value) and the %Error or the percentage deviation of the PV from the SP (the required set-point). As such it is possible to define L, LL, H and HH for the PV and an H and HH alarm for the %Error, for each instance of the PID agent.

title: Proprietary Data Logging to Disk
question: What is Proprietary Data Logging to Disk?
answer: Steps: Adroit provides extensive proprietary historical data logging facilities . As with scanning, any slot of any agent can be configured to have its values historically logged, subject to the proviso that they are of slot type Real , Integer , Boolean or 79 character String (this length excludes the mandatory zero terminator character). When logged, the values are time stamped and are made available, via a DataLog agent , to any client .

title: Proxy Servers
question: What is Proxy Servers?
answer: Steps: A proxy server is an Agent Server that creates proxy agents for agents that exist on remote Agent Servers on the same project because it itself does not contain any configured agents. Since it only contains Proxy agents, it will not support scanning, alarming or datalogging. generally use an empty WGP file. IMPORTANT: If your proxy Agent Server is running as a service, then ensure that the user profile that the Agent Server service uses to log onto the computer HAS the necessary rights to browse the network and connect to the other Agent Servers.

title: Querying Recorded Incidents
question: What is Querying Recorded Incidents?
answer: The AlarmManagement agent provides a dialog from which you can perform various statistical queries to analyse the logged incidents. Many of these queries are derived from the EEMUA 191 guidelines a document created by the Engineering Equipment & Materials Users' Association ( EEMUA) of alarm management guidelines, developed by the users of alarm systems, and is the globally accepted and leading guide to good practice for alarm management.

title: Quick Start to Configure and Record Incidents (Alarms/Events)
question: What is Incident icon colors and their meanings?
answer: The color of the incident icon indicates whether reasons and/or notes are required or not for this incident, as follows: - The white icon means that no reasons or notes are required. - The yellow icon means that ONLY reasons must be specified. - The blue icon means that ONLY notes must be specified. - The red icon means that BOTH reasons and notes must be specified.

title: Real-time Catch-up
question: What is How the Real-time catch-up process works?
answer: The is a process that applies to clustered Agent servers only and not to stand-alone servers. The process occurs during the start up of a standby agent server, if a master agent server is already running. If this is the case, then every agent that is loaded from the WGP file and also supports will request the current state of the agent from the master server and then synchronise itself.

title: Recommendations for using TableLayoutPanel controls
question: What is Recommendations for using TableLayoutPanel controls?
answer: Microsoft recommends that you use the TableLayoutPanel control sparingly. Note: You should NOT use it in all situations that require a resizable layout. The following list describes layouts that benefit most from using the TableLayoutPanel control: - Layouts in which there are multiple parts of the form that resize proportionally to each other. - Layouts that will be modified or generated dynamically at run time, such as data entry forms that have user-customizable fields added or subtracted based on preferences.

title: Remote Service & Monitoring using Melsoft GX Works3 & Robustel Gateway Router
question: How do I configure Remote Service & Monitoring using Melsoft GX Works3 & Robustel Gateway Router in Adroit SCADA?
answer: This guide focuses on establishing a remote connection to the PLC and using GX Works3 for monitoring or program operations. To configure Remote Service & Monitoring, the Robustel Router must be registered on the RCMS Cloud Platform, included in a VPN group, and the RCMS Client enabled. Verify the router is connected to the Robustel VPN and the link is active, and the remote engineer must be a verified VPN user on the Robustel RCMS Cloud Platform.

title: Remote Service & Monitoring using Melsoft GX Works3 & Robustel Gateway Router
question: How do I configure Remote Service & Monitoring using Melsoft GX Works3 & Robustel Gateway Router 2 in Adroit SCADA?
answer: To configure Remote Service & Monitoring using Melsoft GX Works3 & Robustel Gateway Router 2, first connect to the Robustel VPN via the Robustel VPN Manager. Then, configure the PLC connection within GX Works3 by selecting Online → Current Connection Destination, choosing 'Other Connection Method,' selecting Ethernet Board, configuring the PLC IP Address, setting the Response Wait Time, and performing a Connection Test.

question: What is To @ scan a tag:?
answer: Scan the required tag as normal except for the following details: - Device selection: Although ANY device can be selected, it is good engineering practice to restrict all such agent-to-agent scanning to a single pseudo device rather than mixing genuine front-end device communications with agent-to-agent scanning within a single device. Either create a pseudo-device using the Adroit simulation protocol driver or use the ALIASSCAN device, which has been created, by default, for this purpose.

question: What is Scanning Optimization?
answer: The optimization of scanning the process of communicating a value (slot), typically to and/or from a front-end device (FED). typically involves grouping data correctly within front-end devices, so as to prevent fragmentation of the data that usually creates a bottleneck for communication performance. Usually I/Os acquired from the plant are not needed by the SCADA, but are intermingled with the SCADA I/O.

question: What is Scanning Troubleshooting FAQ?
answer: Steps: This topics provides answers to commonly experienced problems/issues associated with scanning: Q: When the Agent Server is started, 3 beeps are heard and the Agent Server disappears. Why does this happen? A: The 3 beeps are produced when a driver is NOT loaded by the Agent Server, which can occur because of the following reasons: - the driver has not been configured and therefore cannot load properly - the port is already in use or does not exist - some other resource has run out.

title: Secondary Port Disabled
question: What is Secondary Port Disabled?
answer: Steps: A device goes into recovery whenever a Read or Write transaction fails. This failure is a 3 step process: - Adroit requests an update from the front-end device. - Timeout Phase: the request is sent to the front end device, and times out or gives an invalid response. - Retry Phase: Step 2 is repeated for the number of retries configured. If the retries are exhausted and there is still no valid response, the driver fails, and the scanning resumes immediately.

title: Server clustering
question: What is SmartUI Server clustering?
answer: Steps: SmartUI How to cluster SmartUI Servers SmartUI Servers can be clustered to provide both load balancing and redundancy. Any number of SmartUI Servers can belong to the same cluster, in which case, they are known as cluster partners. Essentially, all cluster partners ( SmartUI Servers within a cluster), act as if they were a single Server, which means that certain characteristics of ALL the cluster partners in a cluster must be IDENTICALLY configured, as follows: - Server name: this also becomes the name of the cluster to which these cluster partners belong, for instance, all the SmartUI Servers whose Server Name is "MyCluster", belong to the "MyCluster" group of cluster partners.

answer: The WanClient application initiates communications to one or more WanServer applications to fetch or send values of Adroit tags that occur in the Agent Server that is also running on the WanClient computer. title: SIMPDRV - Adroit Simulation Protocol Driver
question: What is Automatically Incrementing Scanned SIMPLC Values:?
answer: To simulate a dynamic situation, the values in memory are automatically incremented, for every scan, by the DB number. The formula is: newvalue = oldvalue + DBnumber In other words, DB 0 will NEVER increment, and if DB100:DW### is scanned, the value will be incremented by 100 each scan. For Digital tags, the value will TOGGLE.

title: SNMP Managed Objects
question: What is SNMP Managed Objects?
answer: Steps: Network devices that are managed by SNMP Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is used to monitor and manage a diverse range of devices on a computer network. expose their management data as managed objects. question: What is Requirements?
answer: The following usage requirements must be met before the SNMPManager agent can monitor and/or manage your network devices: - The device must have a SINGLE (FIXED) IP address. title: The Accumulator Agent
question: What is Operation?
answer: When the agent is first enabled, it works as follows: - If the intervalMode slot property is set to 4, a new period will commence immediately. - If the intervalMode slot property is set to 3, the period will commence immediately but will end at the next synchronised period. - At the end of every period, the value is saved as lastValue and the new value is calculated as inputValue minus startValue .

title: The Accumulator Agent
question: What is Trigger event?
answer: When a occurs: - The agent subtracts the previous interval input value from the current input value to determine the value differential for the current period. - This results in a value which represents “the total production for the last hour or shift or day and so-on” . - It then calculates the rate of change in value, which is the differential value for the current period divided by the interval of this period (value per hour) .

title: The AgentGroup Agent
question: What is The AgentGroup Agent?
answer: Agents that are considered to have something in common can be combined into groups by means of AgentGroup agents. For instance, all agents belonging to the north side of a process plant could be grouped in the NORTH_PLANT agent group. Agent groups may, and usually do, have overlapping memberships (i.e. an agent is allowed to belong to more than one group).

title: The AlarmManagement Agent
question: What is The AlarmManagement Agent?
answer: Alarm Management is an important aspect of process control required to counteract inefficient alarming. Alarm management allows you to create an alarming system that alerts the operator to the most relevant alarm for the current incident. In this case fewer alarms are more effective as the human mind can only focus on a few things at a time.

title: The Alias Agent
question: What is The Alias Agent?
answer: An alias is an assumed or "false" name of another agent. By containing a reference to the agent it is aliasing, appears to have the same Behaviour and state information of the agent it is referencing, differing only in its identity. Aliases can be very useful when attaching Behaviours to picture elements, which are to be repeatedly reused for different scenarios, such as recipes, particularly if the source agent is unknown.

question: What is The ARec Agent?
answer: Steps: or "Associated digital Record" agent, is a fancy version of the Multistate agent that enables the configuration of up to 255 states using truth table type logic on up to 32 bits. title: The Date Agent
question: What is The Date Agent?

title: The DumpConfig Agent
question: What is How it works?

title: The Effect of Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Drivers
question: What is Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Drivers?
answer: Steps: The Effect of Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Note: Asynchronous or non-polling exception-based (telemetry) are particularly affected by shadowed cluster servers. When a second cluster partner, is started, it will start in standby mode and then any Classic UIs configured to attach to this newly started server will display any tags that are linked to "telemetry" device(s) as being "greyed-out" or marked bad. This is by design, since Adroit has no way of knowing what which of these tags are healthy at startup because of the unsolicited nature of these telemetry .

question: What is Creating an IOT agent using expressions in the XML slot?

question: What is Creating an IOT agent using expressions in the XML slot?

title: The PID Agent
question: What is The PID Agent?
answer: Steps: is a simply a faceplate agent for external PID controllers, encapsulating the 25 signals and tuning parameters associated with a PID within a single agent. These values can then be scanned to the outside world, via their raw slots. This provides great savings in the overall number of agents required in the configuration of a project that contains PID controllers. Configurable high and low operation limits are provided for the SP (set-point) and CV (control variable) slots, which will prevent these values from being set to potentially harmful values, when they are being manually configured.

title: The Primitive Agents
question: What is The Primitive Agents?
answer: The primitive agent types Boolean, Integer, Real and String are the simplest building blocks. Instances of these primitive agent types are used simply to hold a single value in the value slot. They do not contain any other slots or additional functionality such as inversion, pulsing, linearisation, etc, as found in the Digital, Analog and other agent types.

title: The Shift Agent
question: What is The Shift Agent?
answer: Steps: Various agents in Adroit , such as OEE, require knowing the current shift number. Instead of configuring the shift pattern information into each instance of these agents, you can instead configure these shift patterns globally, in a Shift agent, for use by any interested agents. The value slot of should also be scanned, output enabled, to any PLCs that perform any shift end functions, such as resetting shift count accumulators.

title: The SystemDatalog Agent
question: What is The SystemDatalog Agent?
answer: Steps: manages the Datalog catch-up of all configured Datalog agents, which only applies to clustered Agent Servers and refers to the process of synchronizing, unsynchronised sections of logged data between the two Agent Server partners in the cluster. This involves fetching stored historical data from the datalog agents on the cluster partner and merging the data with the local datalog agents. Note: For performance reasons, ONLY provides the Time datalog catchup method, of catching up the data between two specified date/times.

title: The Tag-link Database
question: What is The Tag-link Database?
answer: Each WanClient application needs to create and maintain a tag link database. This database stores a list of WanServer(s) and tags whose values are to be fetched or sent to or from each of the Agent Servers residing on these WanServer computers and these database files are stored in the database-folder . The tag link database is typically (initially) created using the WanClient Configurator, which can be launched from the Open Configurator item of the WanClient File menu and is used to stores the following items: - The communication settings of each remote (Wan)Server whose Agent Server contains tags that either need to be fetched or sent.

title: Time Stamping
question: What is Time Stamping?
answer: Adroit achieves its accuracy by data at the point of creation whenever possible. Scanned values get their timestamp from the data packet returned by the front-end device, if the protocol driver is exception based and implements a time-stamping protocol. A time stamp may also be created in an agent when a user enters a value manually.

title: Time Synchronization of an Adroit Cluster
question: What is Time Synchronization?
answer: Steps: It is essential that both the cluster Agent Servers and their clients have their system time synchronised, for clustering to work effectively. This is ALSO critical in a distributed Adroit installation (where there are multiple user interfaces and/or Agent Servers on different computers) that the system times of all of the computers are synchronised to a common source. Adroit will behave unpredictably on a system which system time is not synchronised with the computer it’s connecting to.

title: To Create a Half Hour Average of a Process Input
question: What is To Create a Half Hour Average of a Process Input?
answer: To create a half hourly average of some process input (e.g. TEMP1) that is to be transferred to a database, follow the following method: - Create a half hourly pulse: - Create a digital agent called HALFHOURPULSE and enable a pulse of 100 mS - Create an expression called EX_HALFHOURPULSE with v1=systeminfo.minute, value=HALFHOURPULSE.value and expression=(v1==0)||(v1==30) - Create a half hourly reset pulse that will activate immediately after the half hourly pulse: - Create a digital agent called HALFHOURRESET and enable a pulse of 100 mS.

title: To Edit or Configure a PerfMon Agent
question: What is Configuration?
answer: Steps: The Perfmon agent . Since Adroit is a 32 bit application, if you have installed a 64 bit operating system then when you run the default Performance Monitor (PERFMON.EXE) all the counters for Adroit will be missing, because the 64 bit version of PERFMON is being run which can only load 64bit counter dlls! Therefore, in order to force Windows to load the 32 bit version of PERFMON, open the Command Prompt and specify the following statement: mmc /32 perfmon.msc - Edit an agent of type: PerfMon .

title: To Enable or Disable the Automatic Closing of the OPC Server
question: What is To Enable or Disable the Automatic Closing of the OPC Server?
answer: If enabled, this will automatically close the Adroit OPC Server on this computer, as soon as all its OPC clients have disconnected. Then when an OPC client tries to connect, the OPC Server will start automatically. This is disabled by default. - Click on the Edit menu and select Properties . - Ensure that the Auto close OPC Server on zero clients option is either ticked to enable this or cleared to disable this feature.

title: To Estimate the Disk Space Required for Data Logging
question: What is To Estimate the Disk Space Required for Data Logging?
answer: The user has no direct control over the speed at which the raw data log file will grow. Therefore, it is important to calculate the maximum space each agent may occupy, before the data log file wraps around and overwrites itself from the beginning. This figure can be compared to the actual free disk space available on the host computer.

answer: Steps: The following steps can be taken: - Use only NTFS instead of FAT or FAT32 file partitions2. - Remove "flush lazily" setting on Adroit Logging. The adverse side effect of this is that duty cycle on disk will be much more intense, as every change will be flushed right through to disk. In consequence disk may need replacing after several months/years (who knows). In addition system throughput may be reduced.

title: Toshiba ASCII
question: How do I configure Toshiba ASCII in Adroit SCADA?
answer: The ClosePortOnFailure registry key in the Toshiba ASCII drivers controls whether the port should be closed if ethernet serial extenders hang. The default value for this key is 1, which means the port will be closed if a failure occurs. To change this, add a DWORD key named ClosePortOnFailure with a value of 0 to disable automatic port closure.

answer: Legacy would only attempt to reload the primary and secondary configuration from the registry during an outright fail of the device, once the maximum number of retries were exceeded. title: User Rights Policy
question: What is User Rights Policy?
answer: The Windows manages the rights granted to groups and user accounts. A right authorises a user to perform certain actions on the system. A user who logs on to an account to which the appropriate rights have been granted can carry out the corresponding actions. title: Using SQL Queries within Identify Row
question: What is Using SQL Queries within Identify Row?
answer: For each of the update, delete and retrieve transactions; a row in a table has to be identified, by entering the required identification text into the edit box of Identify row . In most cases, specifying the cell in the required field can uniquely identify the row. The required identification text in Identify row for this case is: FieldName = ‘CellInFieldName’ If more than one field is required to identify a row uniquely, then the row is identified using the "OR" or "AND" SQL keywords.

title: VB Script for DriveXYZ
question: What is VB Script for DriveXYZ?
answer: The fully commented code that provides the additional functionality for DriveXYZ is as follows: Note: If required copy and paste this code (using the Ctrl-V hotkey) into the Adroit Script Editor, for the DriveXYZ derived custom agent. ' define the slot index numbers starting at 0 in the same order as defined in adrcusdes Const idx_Start = 0 Const idx_Stop = 1 Const idx_Value = 2 Const idx_Tripped = 3 Const idx_Speed = 4 Const idx_Temperature = 5 Const idx_HighTemperature = 6 ' define the status bit index numbers starting at 16 in the same order as defined in adrcusdes Const idx_TempHiStatus = 16 Const idx_TripStatus = 17 ' define the constant for three seconds Const ThreeSeconds = 0.00003472 ' 1 second = 1 day / (24 hours * 60 minutes * 60 seconds) StartTime = 0 StopTime = 0 Sub OnCompiled() 'global initialisation - called for each agent at startup and whenever this file is saved 'while AS is running ' DriveXYZ has nothing to do End Sub Sub OnLoadComplete() 'agent initialisation - called for each agent at when agent has been loaded from WGP file or 'newly created ' DriveXYZ - make sure that the start and stop controls are OFF Custom.SetSlot idx_Start, 0 Custom.SetSlot idx_Stop, 0 End Sub Sub OnChange(slotid, value) 'agent slot changed - called whenever a putslot has been done into one of this agents slots 'DriveXYZ - do not allow the drive to start if the temperature is too high if (slotid = idx_Start) AND (value = 1) then if (Custom.GetSlot(idx_Temperature) >= Custom.GetSlot(idx_HighTemperature)) then Custom.SetSlot idx_Start, 0 end if end if 'DriveXYZ - if the drive has tripped, set the trip status bit if slotid = idx_Tripped then Custom.SetStatus idx_TripStatus, value = 1 'DriveXYZ - if the temperature is higher than the configured high temperature value, set the 'high temperature status bit if slotid = idx_Temperature then Custom.SetStatus idx_TempHiStatus, value >= Custom.GetSlot(idx_HighTemperature) end if if slotid = idx_HighTemperature then Custom.SetStatus idx_TempHiStatus, Custom.GetSlot(idx_Temperature) >= value end if 'DriveXYZ - if the start slot is on, save the current start time if (slotid = idx_Start) AND (Value = 1) then StartTime = Now 'DriveXYZ - if the stop slot is on, save the current stop time if (slotid = idx_Stop) AND (Value = 1) then StopTime = Now End Sub Sub OnUpdate(slotid, value) 'agent slot changed - called whenever a tagname type slot receives an update ' DriveXYZ has nothing to do End Sub Sub OnBackground() 'agent background management - called every second 'DriveXYZ - pulse the start and stop slots if (StartTime > 0) AND (Now - StartTime > ThreeSeconds) then Custom.SetSlot idx_Start, 0 StartTime = 0 end if if (StopTime > 0) AND (Now - StopTime > ThreeSeconds) then Custom.SetSlot idx_Stop, 0 StopTime = 0 end if End Sub

question: What is About WanClient?
answer: Wanlink allows data to be replicated over a slow or Wide Area Network (WAN) from one Agent Server to another. The WanClient application initiates communications to one or more WanServer applications to fetch or send values of Adroit tags that occur in the Agent Server that is also running on the WanClient computer. title: What is maximum demand and why should you monitor it?
question: What is maximum demand and why should you monitor it??
answer: Maximum demand is an additional cost for most non-domestic power users. It is the method used by your electricity provider to control how much electricity you use, especially at peak times, when your usage coincides with peak domestic usage. Your maximum demand limit is the maximum amount of electricity that you are allowed to use to run your process during peak demand times, which in South Africa is measured in kVAh.

question: What is new in the Adroit 10 Release 6?
answer: Adroit 10 Release 6 introduced demand scanning of tags, triggered when a subscription to a tag is active, such as when a graphic form with the tag is open. Additionally, logging to ADO (SQL) databases by the Datalog agent is disabled by default, requiring users to utilize the DBLog agent for efficient SQL logging. The Datalog agent's datalog period should be limited to 1 day for operational trending, and historical data is retrieved from backup files when the .LGD file is full.

title: Working with the Click Once Operator install
question: What is Working with the Click Once Operator install?

title: Working with the Health Monitor Service
question: What is What does it do??
answer: - At start-up the service attempts to determine which network cards have Power Saving Enabled. - At start-up the service will attempt to determine the UAC status of the currently logged on user. - The Service will periodically attempt to check the following computer information (every 10 minutes): - Total instantaneous CPU Usage as a % - Total and available Memory (Physical & Virtual) - Drive Information for all drives (Total size and available space) - The Service will periodically check specific processes (every 30 seconds) The default processes are "as.exe", "VIP Designer.exe", "VIP Operator.exe", "VIPServer.exe", "VIPService.exe".

title: Working with the Health Monitor Service
question: What is How to add additional processes to be monitored?
answer: Steps: If necessary, you can add additional Processes to be monitored by the Health Monitor Service. The configuration file resides in installation folder of the Health Monitor Service (typically found - C:\ProgramData\Adroit Technologies\Common\Health Monitor). The configuration file is called HealthMonitorConfig.xml Example Configuration Entry to add the Notepad.exe process to the list of monitored processes, add the following to the end of this file, above the </NewDataSet> line: <Executables> <Executable>Notepad.exe</Executable> <CPUCoreThresholdPercent>2</CPUCoreThresholdPercent> <PrivateBytesLimit>1146880000</PrivateBytesLimit> <PrivateBytesThresholdPercent>80</PrivateBytesThresholdPercent> </Executables>

title: Working with the Health Monitor Service
question: What is How to adjust the default thresholds of the monitored processes?
answer: If necessary, you can adjust the default thresholds of the monitored processes to customise them for your typical system performance. The configuration file resides in installation folder of the Health Monitor Service (typically found - C:\ProgramData\Adroit Technologies\Common\Health Monitor). The configuration file is called HealthMonitorConfig.xml In this file, each specified executable allows you to specify the following thresholds, which specify the normal usage values, which if they are consistently exceeded indicates that there may be a problem and hence the Health Monitor Service will log messages in these instances: - CPUCoreThresholdPercent : This specifies the maximum percentage of the CPU that this process executable should consistently use in normal operation, above which the Health Monitor Service will provide alerts.

answer: Wizards allow you to reuse the same graphical object and its assigned Behaviours (if any), over and over again, with different values (data elements), without having to recreate this object from scratch ever time. In other words, a wizard is a reusable design-time object, much like a Windows control.
